operating_model.topology: Persistent capability groups staff temporary cross-functional deployment pods.

leadership_layers.accountability: Customer outcome scope delivery and operational transition
Architecture quality security and reusable engineering decisions
Capacity prioritization specialist allocation and escalation

roles.title: Security Engineer
accountabilities: Threat model access data protection and release approval

roles.title: Product Partner
accountabilities: Discovery adoption value and product feedback

roles.title: Technical Deployment Lead
accountabilities: Integrated plan decisions risks cutover and handoff

staffing_rules: Every engagement has a named DRI and a different backup DRI.
Risk level 5 requires at least 0.5 architect FTE and 0.5 security FTE.
Go-live requires at least 1.0 platform FTE and 0.5 delivery FTE.
Discovery requires at least 1.0 FDE FTE and 0.5 product FTE.
Pilot requires at least 1.0 AI FTE and 0.5 platform FTE.
No role pool may exceed its target utilization.

scaling_triggers.trigger: Any role exceeds 85 percent utilization for two planning cycles
scaling_triggers.action: Open capacity plan and reduce uncommitted scope

scaling_triggers.trigger: A shared specialist becomes the sole qualified owner for two or more critical engagements
scaling_triggers.action: Assign a shadow and create a dated capability transfer plan

scaling_triggers.trigger: Security or architecture review wait exceeds 10 business days
scaling_triggers.action: Add reviewer capacity or narrow concurrent high-risk work

scaling_triggers.trigger: More than two engagements enter go-live or hypercare together
scaling_triggers.action: Create a temporary command-center rotation and executive priority review

scaling_triggers.trigger: Reusable work exceeds 30 percent of delivery effort
scaling_triggers.action: Fund a dedicated product or platform workstream

anti_hero_controls: Primary and backup DRI on every engagement
Decision and runbook artifacts stored in shared repositories
No critical approval dependent on one person

career_levels.evidence: Delivers a bounded workstream with support
Owns an engagement slice and customer decisions
Sets technical direction across engagements and develops specialists
Builds capability capacity and consistent delivery systems
